stories.label: User stories
stories.title: Daily life changed after sharing things

camping.title: I reduced clutter by borrowing only when needed
camping.body: For items like camping chairs and lanterns that I rarely use, I borrow locally and return them right away. My home feels lighter and costs are lower.

appliance.title: Short-term needs solved without buying
appliance.body: By sharing appliances like food dehydrators or steam irons that I only need during specific seasons, I avoid expensive purchases that sit unused.

childcare.title: Neighbors rotate short-use items naturally
childcare.body: By sharing baby products with short usage windows in the neighborhood, we can help each other right when it's needed.

tools.title: I can quickly find one-time-use tools
tools.body: I can borrow occasional-use tools like power drills nearby, so even small home repairs get done much faster.

reasons.label: Ask experts
reasons.title: Why sharing things matters for us

light-consumption.title: Lighter consumption
light-consumption.body: When we focus on usage over ownership, one item can help more people solve needs at the right moment.

local-connection.title: Stronger local ties
local-connection.body: As local borrow-and-return habits settle in, trusted relationships naturally grow in the neighborhood.

circular-use.title: Sustainable circulation
circular-use.body: When one item is used by many people, its lifespan grows and unnecessary purchases and waste can be reduced.
